title: Tiffany Trump Embarrassed After Her September Photo Dump Is Flagged by Instagram For AI Content
source_used: Daily Mail (via Google News search; IMDb page unreadable)
key_facts: Tiffany Trump, 32, shared a 'Scenes from September' photo carousel on Instagram on Thursday.
Instagram flagged the carousel as containing 'AI content'.
The Daily Mail says it is unclear which image used AI.
The photos included a trip to Mumbai, Central Park and the recent White House state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping.
quote_evidence: the carousel of images was flagged by Instagram for containing 'AI content.'
why_it_matters_hint: Instagram's automatic AI label is now landing on ordinary personal photos, even of public figures.
notes: The IMDb page returned no text; IMDb carries entertainment-news copy and appears to repeat the Daily Mail story. Daily Mail text read instead. Daily Mail says Tiffany 'appeared' to have used AI editing, which is an assumption; the label could also come from ordinary editing tools. Older than window; score already at the floor.
